messages:
Maya: FYI the nightly microbench flagged a regression for candidate kernel v3 at seq_len=512 on Ampere. p95 looks noticeably worse.
perf-bot: [auto] run 1777770000: candidate v3 vs baseline v2 — p50 +12%, p95 +18%. full diff: https://ci.internal/runs/1777770000
Liam: ouch. can you share the exact harness command/config? was batching enabled?
Maya: ran: ```./run_microbench --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iters 200 --batch-policy auto --kernel v3``` on node ampere-rtg-09
Rahul: quick checklist: (1) KV cache on? (2) batch window ms? (3) driver/firmware mismatch? tiling change in v3 could be sensitive to seqlen.
Maya: KV cache: enabled; batch-window=4ms; driver: NVIDIA 520.61
Olivia: infra note: ampere-rtg-09 had a kernel panicked pod and kubelet restart around 02:14 UTC — possible noise source. filing infra ticket.
Liam: can we repro on a clean node? I'll allocate ampere-ml01 and rerun the same harness pinned to that host.
perf-bot: re-run 1777770045 finished: v3 on ampere-ml01 vs baseline => p50 +3%, p95 +5%. variance much smaller.
Rahul: that points to infra noise, but there is still a small delta. v3 introduced fused-conv-tiling heuristics; on Ampere/seq=512 tiling may pick a suboptimal path. try forcing arch-aware picks to fallback.
Maya: ran with env override: ```REDWOOD_KERNEL_PICK=arch_aware:force_skip_tiling=true ./run_microbench --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iters 200 --batch-policy auto --kernel v3``` -> p50 -1%, p95 -2% vs baseline. so fallback fixes it.
Liam: good repro. proposed CI changes: (1) add gating rule to candidate pipeline to require arch-aware fallback check for seq lengths:512/1024, (2) add a pinned-node reproducibility job that runs repeat=5 and aggregates p50/p95, (3) expand the nightly microbench to capture driver/kernel versions.
Rahul: I'll open a kernel PR to add a lightweight seq_len threshold heuristic and a flag to opt-out tiling per-arch. also add the microbench config to the candidate CI matrix.
Olivia: I'll create a node pool with label "perf-dedicated" and ensure it's pinned to a stable driver (NVIDIA 520.61) for the repro job. add quota so nightly runs don't evict.
Maya: action items captured. I'll update the perf triage doc with links and mark candidate v3 as "blocked for autotune heuristic" until Rahul's PR lands and CI gating is in place. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
notes: thread focused on kernel v3 regression at seq_len=512; repro steps, infra noise, env overrides, CI gating and action items recorded
